what: For a chosen note under docs/ with a '## Falsifiers' section: implement ONE falsifier as an independent script (floating point allowed, a different method from the runner), put it under probes/work/<note-stub>/, and run it through run_probe with --extra 'python3 probes/work/<stub>/<script>.py'. Print a line 'HIT: ...' if the falsifier fires and a final 'SUMMARY: ...' line. Never edit the note or the runner. Choose notes from open science PRs first.

For a chosen note: reimplement its central computation from the note's statement alone, without reading the runner, in a different method; compare the numbers; print 'HIT: ...' on disagreement and a 'SUMMARY: ...' line; run through run_probe with --extra as above. Disagreement is reported, not resolved.
